split-vep.label: Extract VEP consequences (+split-vep)
split-vep.description: Extract one row per synthetic VEP consequence, including its position, consequence and gene symbol.

fill-tags.label: Calculate allele counts and frequencies (+fill-tags)
fill-tags.description: Calculate AN, AC, AF and NS from the example genotypes. Missing, haploid and multiallelic calls exercise different counting rules.

trio-stats.label: Summarize trio transmission (+trio-stats)
trio-stats.description: Read the synthetic family pedigree and report trio transmission statistics.

mendelian.label: Count Mendelian inconsistencies
mendelian.description: Count consistency and missingness in the synthetic trio. The preset uses the corresponding upstream Mendelian plugin for each version.

trio-dnm.label: Annotate possible de novo genotypes (+trio-dnm2)
trio-dnm.description: Demonstrate the genotype-only NAIVE model on the synthetic trio. This flags genotype patterns, not confirmed de novo variants.

trio-switch-rate.label: Inspect trio phase switches (+trio-switch-rate)
trio-switch-rate.description: Calculate the phase-switch summary for the phased calls in the synthetic trio.

plugins.label: List built-in BCFtools plugins
plugins.description: List the plugins compiled into this version of BCFtools. Edit the arguments to run any listed plugin.

bcf.label: Convert VCF to BCF
bcf.description: Encode the example variants in compressed BCF. Retain variants.bcf for further BCFtools commands.

query.label: Query variant genotypes
query.description: Print positions, alleles and genotypes as a tab-separated table.

samtools-sort.label: Sort alignments to BAM
samtools-sort.description: Sort the synthetic alignments by coordinate and retain a BAM file for indexing or inspection.

samtools-index.label: Index the generated BAM
samtools-index.description: Run Sort alignments to BAM first. Create a BAI index for sorted.bam.

samtools-count.label: Count alignments
samtools-count.description: Count records in the example SAM file.

samtools-cram.label: Encode alignments as CRAM
samtools-cram.description: Encode the example alignments using the supplied synthetic reference. Keep the reference with the CRAM file for later decoding.

samtools-faidx.label: Extract a reference interval
samtools-faidx.description: Index the synthetic reference and extract chr1:95-135 as FASTA.

bgzip.label: BGZF-compress the VCF
bgzip.description: Compress the VCF to BGZF through binary standard output. The result can be indexed with tabix.

tabix-index.label: Index the compressed VCF
tabix-index.description: Run BGZF-compress the VCF first. Create a tabix index for variants.vcf.gz.

tabix-query.label: Query the indexed VCF
tabix-query.description: Run the compression and tabix-index presets first. Retrieve records at chr1:90-150 through the index.

htsfile.label: Identify an input format
htsfile.description: Inspect the example SAM input with the HTSlib format-identification utility.

version.label: Show BCFtools and HTSlib versions
version.description: Print the versions of BCFtools and its linked HTSlib.

synthetic.label: Synthetic trio, VEP annotations and alignments
synthetic.description: Small deterministic controls with a four-sample VCF, structured CSQ annotations, family pedigree, synthetic SAM reads and matching reference. These examples include missing, haploid and multiallelic genotypes; they contain no individual’s data.
